svg.title: git-repo-publish — a boarding pass for your first publish
svg.desc: A boarding pass from a local project to owner/repo on GitHub. It lists the preview fields the skill shows before publishing: account, owner, visibility, protocol, branch and full commit SHA. The stub is stamped "awaiting confirmation" at the --confirm-target gate.

g.aria-label: COMMIT · FULL SHA, READ BACK AFTER PUSH
